Explore the atlas

The atlas is a zoomable map of every route, town, cave and forest. Use Johto and Kanto at the top to switch region, and Overview to see the whole region at once.

Select a map to open it. The sidebar lists its wild Pokémon, its items and where it connects. Entrance markers (↗) take you into caves and other areas. Inside a cave, every floor is drawn side by side, and the floor you arrive on is outlined and briefly flashes.

Markers: ● items and T TMs / HMs sit where you find them. ▣ marks a building with items inside, listed by floor. ⌂ is a gate or passage to another area, and lists any items inside too. ♟ opens a trainer’s party, and ✦ is a Pokémon you battle on the map. A numbered circle groups markers that are close together. Use the chips to show or hide each kind.

Drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom. Tile grid draws the game’s tile squares once you zoom in. Search finds maps, items and trainers. The link in the address bar can be bookmarked or shared.
